svg.title: DeepSWE v1.1 task completion versus cost
svg.desc: DeepSWE v1.1 on 113 tasks using Codex CLI and GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol. Plan/Execute: 60.8% ± 5.3 at $180.51 ± 9.43 per run. Advisor: 57.5% ± 3.2 at $208 ± 22 per run. Stage: 61.36% ± 6.02 at $466.28 ± $8.83 per run, averaged over 3 runs. One baseline per model, selected by highest reported completion score, with lower cost breaking ties: Sol: 62.8% ± 3.1 at $720.95 ± 19.47, from the Plan/Execute study; Luna: 52.2% at about $49, the better of two valid runs from the Advisor study. Sol and the routed points are three-run means; Luna is an individual run. Reported ± values are sample standard deviations.
